title: Fusion Leverage Bot
tagline: Telegram bot that allows you to submit leveraged limit orders using Fusion API and Aave

prizes.title: Build an Innovative Application on top of 1inch Network's Fusion API

description:
Fusion limit orders are great in that they avoid expensive gas fees, frontrunning and AMM slippage. However, there is no current method to easily and in a user friendly UX take leveraged positions with limit orders. 

By using a Telegram bot interface, we are able to allow users to easily take leveraged limit orders. 

**Links**
- [https://github.com/taetaehoho/fusionleverage](https://github.com/taetaehoho/fusionleverage)
- [https://www.loom.com/share/47309ded1e5c44e2ba6325f5eb094497?sid=29221d59-16da-4b0d-89d2-6c79a84e8d0f](https://www.loom.com/share/47309ded1e5c44e2ba6325f5eb094497?sid=29221d59-16da-4b0d-89d2-6c79a84e8d0f)
how_its_made: The largest issue I ran into was that Fusion API is not available on testnet. In order to test whether or not it worked, we had to spin up a burner mainnet wallet and test using real ETH and USDC.
